clips.place: Osaka Castle above its stone walls and moat at golden hour
clips.keyframe_prompt: Osaka Castle at golden hour: the white and green-roofed main keep with gold ornaments rising above massive curved stone walls, a calm wide moat in the foreground reflecting the castle and warm sky, autumn trees in orange and yellow along the walls, low angle from across the moat, no people, no boats

Slow, smooth upward tilt from the moat to the castle keep, then the camera holds still for the final second.
